review_findings.fixed_geometry: Every positive-epsilon decision is bound to one 16-source by 16-output block; incomplete, duplicate, alien and 8/32-wide mutations fail closed.
review_findings.epsilon_zero: The zero point accepts no decision rows and requires exact AEE and cycle equality; metadata and savings are exactly zero.
review_findings.metadata: Every decision over every positive-epsilon block costs exactly two bytes, including keep decisions; denominator is the paired baseline weight bytes for the same blocks.
review_findings.causal_savings: A dropped block is credited only when its decision cycle is strictly earlier than each of weight fetch, compute and psum starts. Saved resource quantities come only from the paired baseline ledger; injected candidate savings have no effect.
review_findings.paired_metrics: The exact ordered 40-sample cohort is enforced. AEE is paired per sample and averaged overall and by sequence. Cycle speedup is sum(baseline cycles)/sum(candidate cycles), never mean of per-sample ratios.
review_findings.fixed_gate: overall delta <=0.02, every-sequence delta <=0.03, metadata ratio <=2%, and same-resource local speedup >=1.15x are all visible and conjunctive.
review_findings.tsbg: If TSBG is admitted, its receipt and admitted-TSBG same-resource baseline are mandatory. Component speedup multiplication is rejected.
review_findings.claim_boundary: The reviewed artifact is an inert accounting source. It has no payload loader or actual evaluation CLI and cannot admit AEE, cycles, speedup, paper results, RTL or EDA claims.

p2_open_condition.name: future_candidate_cycle_provenance
p2_open_condition.detail: Candidate cycle_count is intentionally supplied by the future runner rather than derived by this accounting kernel. Before any execution release, the runner must generate and seal candidate cycles under the exact same cycle/resource model as the baseline; caller-provided cycle numbers alone are not evidence.
